name: Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the 1 pound whole chicken dry with paper towels.
Rub all over with 2 tablespoons olive oil and season generously with 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 2 teaspoons dried rosemary.
Scatter the 2 1/2 cups carrots around the pan. Roast 45 minutes, until cooked through and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle. Serve warm.
